Great local food
Sep 2017 • Friends
I was brought there by a friend otherwise I would never have discovered this gem. Prices are reasonable towards the cheaper end. Menu is pretty limited but it is very good. As I recall, the menu was all in Vietnamese so it is not foreigner friendly. The staff does not seem to be English conversanrt. So if you ever go there without your local friends, just look around and see what the locals are eating and just point. 

The pancakes or banh khot is really good. It comes with a lot of vegetables and herbs. You are to wrap the banh khot and the vegetables, mainly fresh lettuces and dip them into the fish sauce. They have a whole jug of the fish sauce on each table.
